blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Narrative-driven recommendation allows users to express multifaceted needs through free-form text where stated preferences naturally qualify and condition one another. Existing methods typically treat narratives as flat keyword combinations or unconstrained generative queries, failing to capture how complex preferences hierarchically refine and contextualize each other. We propose the Preference Dependency Graph Framework (PDG-F), a narrative-driven recommendation framework centered on explicit preference dependencies. Specifically, PDG-A (PDG-Agent) first parses unstructured requests to organize user preferences and their mutual qualifications into a directed acyclic Preference Dependency Graph (PDG). Through this graph, candidate evidence from the open Web is acquired via directed path retrieval, and final recommendations are determined by topological path ranking. Comprehensive experiments across three diverse domains spanning English and Chinese contexts confirm that PDG-F consistently achieves superior recommendation performance over competitive baselines, open-domain retrieval agents, and frontier language models. Further diagnostic analyses show that our dependency-guided retrieval markedly raises the attainable candidate-pool ceiling, demonstrating the fundamental value of modeling preference dependencies in narrative-driven recommendation.
blocks.zh: 叙述式驱动的建议允许用户通过自由格式文本表达多方面的需求,其中所声明的偏好自然符合条件并互为条件。 现有方法通常将叙事作为平分关键词组合或不受约束的基因查询处理,未能捕捉到复杂偏好在分层次上如何细化和背景化彼此. 我们提出优先依赖性图表框架(PDG-F),这是一个以明确的优先依赖性为中心的叙事性建议框架。 具体来说,PDG-A(PDG-Agent)首先将无结构化的要求组织用户偏好及其相互的资质,纳入一个直接的循环偏好依赖图(PDG). 通过此图,通过定向路径检索获取了从开放的Web获得的候选证据,最终建议由地形路径排名决定. 跨越英语和中国语背景的三个不同领域的综合实验证实,PDG-F在竞争基线、开放域检索代理和前沿语言模型上一贯实现优异的推荐性能。 进一步的诊断分析表明,我们的依赖性指导检索明显提高了可实现的候选人总数上限,表明在叙事性建议中建立依赖性模型的根本价值。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en: Relevance to Web. Traditional recommender systems on Web platforms largely rely on historical interactions or structured profiles to approximate user intent ( Adomavicius and Tuzhilin, 2005 ; Koren et al., 2009 ) . However, these signals often fall short as modern Web users increasingly turn to free-form natural language narratives ( Jannach et al., 2021 ; Kang et al., 2017 ; Li et al., 2018 ) . While the emergence of large language models (LLMs) offers new opportunities to interpret such narratives ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Geng et al., 2022 ; Sanner et al., 2023 ) , retrieving candidates from open Web resources and evaluating their suitability require preserving how users’ preferences condition and constrain one another. Against this backdrop, we study narrative-driven recommendation (NDR) in open-web environments, aiming to provide personalized recommendations by deciphering rich, unstructured user requests ( Bogers and Koolen, 2017 ; Afzali et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 与Web的相关性.Web平台上的传统推荐人系统主要依靠历史互动或结构化的配置来大致了解用户意图(Adomavicius和Tuzhilin,2005年;Koren等人,2009年)。 然而,这些信号往往与现代的 网络用户越来越多地转向自由形式的自然语言叙事(Jannach等人,2021年;Kang等人,2017年;Li等人,2018年). 虽然大型语言模型(LLMs)的出现为解释这类叙事提供了新的机会(Wu等人,2024年;Geng等人,2022年;Sanner等人,2023年),公开检索候选人. 网络资源和评价其适宜性需要保持用户的偏好条件和相互制约。 在这种背景下,我们研究了在开放的网络环境中由叙述驱动的建议(NDR),目的是通过破译富有,无结构的用户请求来提供个性化的建议(Bogers and Koolen, 2017;Afzali等人, 2021).

blocks.en: Existing efforts have explored different paradigms to transform narratives into recommendation evidence. Early work primarily relied on explicit clues. For example, Bogers and Koolen ( Bogers and Koolen, 2018 ) combined example items with narrative context. Eberhard et al. ( Eberhard et al., 2019 ) used annotated genres and keywords for post-filtering. Subsequent work further explored automated element extraction to reduce manual annotation ( Eberhard et al., 2024 ) . Another line explores semantic matching between narratives and items through embedding representations ( Eberhard et al., 2020 ) . Recent work further explores the potential of directly generating recommendations from narratives with LLMs ( He et al., 2023 ; Eberhard et al., 2025 ) . To further empower LLMs with external evidence, Zhu et al. ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) introduce collaborative retrieval to provide behavioral signals. Shi et al. ( Shi et al., 2025 ) apply open-domain retrieval and attribute completion to rank candidates. Kanchi et al. ( Kanchi et al., 2026 ) utilize generated plot tags for fine-grained reranking. However, preferences expressed in narratives often mutually qualify each other ( Partee, 1984 ) , a dimension still insufficiently modeled in existing methods.

blocks.en: User preferences in narratives are not merely flat collections of independent elements, but rather hierarchical and dependency structures formed through conditional qualifications. Consider the following movie recommendation request: “I’d like fantasy with romance as a subplot, rather than the main attraction. […] I need believable individual characters and a relationship shown through conversation, humour, and handling disagreements, not mostly sex.” In this query, “subplot” constrains the prominence of romance within the overarching narrative, while conversation, humour, and handling disagreements further qualify the specific manner in which this relationship unfolds. Neglecting such qualifying dependencies can easily cause a film that superficially covers fantasy, romance, and humor to be falsely identified as a match, such as The Lord of the Rings . Yet the humor belongs to camaraderie instead of romance, failing the qualification. In contrast, Howl’s Moving Castle develops the romance through bickering and everyday interaction, satisfying the requested dynamic. This contrast reveals the necessity of explicitly modeling qualification and dependency structures among narrative preferences to guide the retrieval and evaluation of Web evidence for recommendation.
blocks.zh: 叙事中的用户偏好不仅仅是对独立要素的平面集合,而是通过有条件的限定条件形成的等级和依赖结构. 考虑以下电影推荐请求:“我想把浪漫的幻想作为副片, [...] 我需要一个令人难以置信的个人人物和一种通过对话、幽默和处理分歧,而不是多数是性关系表现出来的关系。” 在这个疑问中,“子plot”限制了浪漫在总体叙述中的突出地位,而对话、幽默和处理分歧则进一步限定了这种关系的具体发展方式。 忽略这种资格依赖很容易导致一部表面覆盖幻想,浪漫,幽默的电影被错误地认定为配乐,如"魔戒之王"(The Lord of the Rings). 然而幽默属于友情而非浪漫,没有资格. 对比之下,Howl's Moveing Castle通过争吵和日常互动来发展浪漫,满足了所要求的动态. 这一对比表明,有必要在叙述性偏好中明确建立资格和依赖性结构的模型,以指导网络证据的检索和评价,以供推荐。

blocks.en: We propose PDG-F (Preference Dependency Graph Framework), a narrative-driven recommendation framework comprising a graph construction agent, directed path retrieval, and topological path ranking. Specifically, the graph construction agent, PDG-A, extracts diverse elements from the narrative description and unfolds them into discrete nodes through a two-layer structure of perspective and instantiation. On this basis, PDG-A evaluates the qualification relationships between node pairs within the context of the entire narrative to form directed edges. After resolving cycles, it generates the concrete preference for each current node in topological order conditioned on the preference context of its ancestral nodes, allowing upstream preferences to be progressively refined with each additional qualification to complete the preference dependency graph (PDG). Relying on this PDG, we first acquire candidates and their associated evidence from the open Web via directed path retrieval, and then compute candidate scores through topological path ranking, ultimately delivering recommendation results that better fit the specific preferences of the user.
blocks.zh: 我们提出PDG-F(优先依赖性图表框架),这是一个由叙事驱动的建议框架,由图表构建剂、定向路径检索和地形路径排名组成。 具体地说,图建剂PDG-A从叙事描述中提取了不同的元素,并通过视角和即时化的两层结构将它们展开为离散的节点. 在此基础上,PDG-A在全叙事的背景中评价节点对子之间的资格关系,形成定向边缘. 在解决周期后,它以祖先节点的偏好背景为条件,在地形顺序上产生对每个当前节点的具体偏好,使上游偏好随着每个附加条件逐渐完善,以完成偏好依赖图(PDG). 依靠这个PDG,我们首先通过定向路径检索从开放的Web获取候选人及其相关证据,然后通过地形路径排名计算候选人得分,最终提供更符合用户具体偏好的建议结果.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows. • We propose PDG-F (Preference Dependency Graph Framework), a narrative-driven recommendation framework that organizes user qualifying constraints into a progressively refined directed dependency structure, providing a principled structural representation for complex composite preferences. • We develop a structure-guided decision mechanism built directly upon the constructed PDG (Preference Dependency Graph), comprising directed path retrieval to acquire candidate evidence from the Web under specific qualification constraints and topological path ranking to compute candidate scores, thereby unifying evidence gathering and final recommendation under a coherent structure. • We conduct comprehensive experiments across three distinct domains encompassing movies, books, and anime in both English and Chinese contexts, demonstrating that PDG-F consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance against competitive baselines as well as modern commercial retrieval engines alongside frontier models and LLM agents, with ablations and diagnostic analyses verifying the efficacy of dependency modeling.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下。 我们提出PDG-F(优先依赖性图表框架),这是一个由叙事驱动的建议框架,将用户资格限制组织到逐步完善的直接依赖结构中,为复杂的综合优惠提供原则性的结构代表。 我们发展了一种结构指导决策机制,该机制直接以已构建的PDG(优先依赖性图)为基础,包括定向路径检索,以在具体的资格限制和地形路径排名下从网上获取候选人证据,以计算候选人的分数,从而统一证据收集和最终推荐,置于一个连贯的结构之下。 我们从英语和中文的角度,在电影、书籍和动画三个不同领域进行了全面试验,表明PDG-F在竞争性基线以及现代商业检索引擎与前沿模型和LLM剂一起,始终能实现最新性能,同时进行模拟和诊断分析,核实依赖性模型的功效。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Translating natural narratives into accurate item recommendations hinges on effectively understanding and operationalizing the multifaceted needs woven into unstructured text. Guided by varying depths of textual interpretation and representation paradigms, existing efforts have broadly evolved across three paradigms: explicit feature matching, representation learning, and LLM-based recommendation with evidence augmentation.
blocks.zh: 将自然叙述转化为准确的项目建议,取决于能否有效理解和操作编织成无结构文本的多方面需求。 以文字解释和表述范式的不同深度为指导,现有工作在三个范式中发生了广泛演变:明确特征匹配、表述学习和基于LLM的建议与证据增强。

blocks.en: Explicit feature matching focuses on distilling concrete recommendation signals from unstructured narratives through signal integration, request element extraction, and narrative trope generation. Early work by Bogers and Koolen ( Bogers and Koolen, 2018 ) combined narrative context with referenced example items to exploit the complementarity between explicit exemplars and descriptive intent. To obtain more specific recommendation cues, Eberhard et al. ( Eberhard et al., 2024 ) automated the extraction of request elements into discrete recommendation cues, while Kanchi et al. ( Kanchi et al., 2026 ) generated narrative trope tags from book descriptions to incorporate specific story patterns into candidate reranking. However, these methods primarily organize recommendation around feature matching, still lacking explicit representations for the modifier and qualification relationships among preference elements.
blocks.zh: 明确特征匹配侧重于通过信号集成,请求元素提取,以及叙事trope生成,从无结构化的叙述中提炼出具体推荐信号. Bogers和Koolen(Bogers和Koolen,2018年)的早期工作将叙述背景与引用的例子项目相结合,以利用明确实例和描述意图之间的互补性. 为了获得更具体的建议提示,Eberhard等人, (Eberhard等人, 2024年)自动化地将请求要素提取到离散的推荐提示中,而Kanchi等人则自动提取. (Kanchi et al., 2026)从书籍描述中生成了叙事trope标记,将具体的故事模式纳入候选重排. 然而,这些方法主要围绕特征匹配来组织建议,仍然缺乏对修饰者的明确表述和优惠要素之间的资格关系。

blocks.en: Representation learning approaches compute relevance by learning semantic correspondences between narrative requests and items, expanding from embedding-based matching ( Reimers and Gurevych, 2019 ; Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) to task adaptation, data augmentation, and general-purpose representation transfer. Early work by Eberhard et al. ( Eberhard et al., 2020 ) leveraged embedding representations to analyze the predictive utility of distinct request elements, while Chaganty et al. ( Chaganty et al., 2023 ) adopted contrastive learning to train dual-encoder retrieval models between conversational context and songs. Addressing the sparsity of narrative supervision, Mysore et al. ( Mysore et al., 2023 ) utilized LLMs to synthesize narrative queries from user interactions, providing supervision for dense retrieval models. To better capture domain semantics, Epure et al. ( Epure et al., 2024 ) fine-tuned models to align natural language requests with high-level track descriptions. Broadening the scope to general recommendation and search, Attimonelli et al. ( Attimonelli et al., 2025 ) validated the zero-shot capabilities of general-purpose text embeddings. Although these efforts substantially advance semantic relevance modeling, they still lack explicit characterization of the qualification scope and inter-dependencies among diverse preference criteria.

blocks.en: LLM-based methods leverage powerful language understanding and reasoning capabilities to interpret narrative intents, evolving from direct generation relying on internal parametric knowledge toward evidence-augmented paradigms that integrate external retrieval and structured attributes ( Lewis et al., 2020 ) . Eberhard et al. ( Eberhard et al., 2025 ) systematically evaluated different models and prompting strategies, benchmarking the feasibility and boundaries of directly generating recommendations from parametric memory. To alleviate the limitations of static parametric knowledge, subsequent efforts focus on equipping LLMs with external grounding evidence: Zhu et al. ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) integrated collaborative retrieval into conversational recommendation to inject behavioral signals for candidate generation, while Shi et al. ( Shi et al., 2025 ) utilized dynamic attribute templates, open-domain retrieval, and attribute completion to construct structured profiles for fine-grained candidate comparison. Despite enriching the grounding evidence for candidates, these approaches still do not explicitly leverage preference dependencies to coordinate retrieval and candidate evaluation.

(Eberhard等人,2025年)系统地评价了不同的模型,并促使制定战略,为直接从参数内存产生建议的可行性和界限设定基准。 为了减轻静态参数化知识的局限性,随后的努力侧重于为LLMS配备外部的地面证据:  Zhu等. (Zhu等人,2025年)将协作检索整合到对话建议中,为候选生成注入行为信号,而Shi等人. Preference dependencies represent user needs as structural relationships between nodes, whereas Web retrieval requires concrete search expressions capable of capturing these compositional qualifications. blocks.en: 4.1. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1. 实验设置

blocks.en: Following the experimental setup of OCG-Agent ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , we first adopt Reddit MovieSuggestions, a widely used benchmark for narrative-driven recommendation ( Eberhard et al., 2019 ; Eberhard et al., 2020 ; Eberhard et al., 2024 ; Eberhard et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . We seek to further validate the capability of PDG-F across diverse tasks. Given that the proprietary education ( Shi et al., 2025 ) dataset is not publicly accessible, we instead collect two datasets from public online communities, namely Book with 30 English queries from Reddit and Anime with 30 Chinese queries from Xiaohongshu and Zhihu.
blocks.zh: OCG-Agent的实验设置(Shi等人,2025年)之后,我们首先采用了Reddit MovieSugrects,这是一个广泛用于叙事性推荐的基准(Eberhard等人,2019年;Eberhard等人,2020年;Eberhard等人,2024年;Eberhard等人,2025年;Shi等人,2025年). 我们力求进一步验证项目DG-F在各种任务方面的能力。 鉴于专有教育(Shi等人,2025年)数据集不公开,我们从公共在线社区收集了两个数据集,即Book,Reddit的30个英文查询和Anime的30个中文查询和小红须和Zhihu的查询。

blocks.en: We adapt the curation methodology of Reddit MovieSuggestions ( Eberhard et al., 2019 ) to construct these two benchmarks. For each sample, the input query is obtained by faithfully summarizing an informative recommendation post while preserving user preferences, constraints, and contextual details. The ground-truth items are scored based on community support, defined by the peak engagement achieved across recommending replies, namely the net vote score on Reddit or the like count on Xiaohongshu and Zhihu. When reliable engagement scores are unavailable for a query, we quantify community support by recommendation frequency within the collected replies.
blocks.zh: 我们修改了Reddit MovieSugretments(Eberhard等人,2019年)的校准方法,以构建这两个基准. 每个样本的输入查询都是通过忠实总结一个信息丰富的推荐帖子获得的,同时保留了用户的偏好,限制和背景细节. 地面真相项目是以社区支持为基础评分的,其定义是建议答复时达到的高峰参与,即Reddit净得分或类似对小红须和Zhihu的净得分。 如果无法提供可靠的参与分数查询,我们在所收集的答复中按建议频率量化社区支助。

blocks.en: We evaluate recommendation performance using Precision@10, Recall@10, and NDCG@10 ( Järvelin and Kekäläinen, 2002 ; Manning et al., 2008 ) . For each query, we follow the original setting of OCG-Agent ( Shi et al., 2025 ) by performing retrieval once and running RankGPT reranking ( Sun et al., 2023 ) three times, reporting the averaged results. For our method, PDG-F, ranking scores are computed deterministically from the constructed graph and collected evidence, so a single ranking run is sufficient.

Given the continuing improvements in LLM capabilities, we rerun experiments with frontier models, including three leading Chinese models, Qwen-3.8-27B, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and MiniMax-M3, as well as GPT-6-Astra, a leading international model. We also include Perplexity, a widely used commercial AI search engine. We set the reasoning effort to high for all models except GPT-6-Astra, which uses xhigh . For OCG-Agent ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , we reproduce its pipeline using
Qwen-3.8-27B as the LLM backbone. Our method, PDG-F, uses the same Qwen-3.8-27B backbone, which we deploy locally on four H20 GPUs with 140 GB of memory each. blocks.en: 4.2. Result Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2. 结果分析

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes the performance comparison across the three benchmark datasets. Overall, our proposed PDG-F (+Year) achieves the best performance on all three datasets across all evaluation metrics. Specifically, on the Movie dataset, PDG-F (+Year) outperforms the strongest competing baselines by 13.7%, 14.1%, and 19.6% in P@10, R@10, and NDCG@10, respectively. The gains are even larger on the Book and Anime benchmarks, where PDG-F (+Year) achieves a 92.4% improvement in P@10 on Book and a 60.9% gain in R@10 on Anime over the best competing methods. These consistent improvements across diverse domains substantiate the value of explicitly modeling preference dependencies and integrating supporting evidence for narrative-driven recommendation.
blocks.zh: 表1汇总了三个基准数据集的业绩比较。 总体而言,我们提议的PDG-F(+年)在所有三个数据集上在所有评价指标上都取得了最佳业绩。 具体来说,在电影数据集中,PDG-F(+ Year)分别比最强的竞争基线高13.7%、14.1%和19.6%,分别为P@10、R@10和NDCG@10。 在《书》和《Anime》基准上,收益更大,其中PDG-F(+年)在《书》上的P@10上提高了92.4%,在《Anime》上的R@10上提高了60.9%。 不同领域的这些持续改进证实了明确模拟偏好依赖性并将支持证据纳入叙事性建议的价值。

blocks.en:
The performance disparities across domains and model variants may partly reflect temporal retrieval biases and differences in knowledge coverage. First, web search often favors recent and popular content, whereas the Movie benchmark frequently targets historical or classic titles.
Accordingly, the (+Year) variant applies rule-based temporal comparison and filtering using the extracted release year metadata to exclude candidates that violate temporal constraints.
Incorporating year information helps counter this mismatch by reducing the prominence of newer candidates, yielding substantial gains on Movie while gains on Anime remain more limited. Second, classic movie plots and item profiles are likely well represented in LLM pretraining corpora, helping direct prompting remain competitive on Movie. Newer or less documented content in Book and Anime may be less well covered by parametric knowledge, making external retrieval more valuable in these domains.
blocks.zh:
不同领域和模式变体的绩效差异可能部分反映出时间检索偏差和知识覆盖面的差异。 首先,网页搜索往往倾向于最近流行的内容,而电影基准常常针对历史或经典标题。
因此,(+年)变量采用基于规则的时间比较和过滤方法,利用所提取的发布年元数据来排除违反时间限制的候选人。
纳入年度信息有助于消除这种不匹配现象,减少较新候选人的知名度,在电影方面产生实质性收益,而在Anime方面则仍然比较有限。 第二,经典的电影情节和物品简介很可能在LLM预训公司(corpora)中得到很好的体现,帮助直接激励在电影上保持竞争力. Book和Anime中较新的或较少的文件内容可能不太被参数化知识涵盖,使得外部检索在这些领域更有价值.

blocks.en: 5. Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 5. 读写研究

blocks.en: 5.1. Candidate Recall Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.1. 候选人召回分析

blocks.en: We compare the candidate acquisition of PDG-F and OCG-Agent across overall pool coverage, relevant item overlap, and ranking-level Recall@ k k .
blocks.zh: 我们在整个人才库覆盖面、相关项目重叠和排名级召回@kk.进行PDG-F和OCG-Agent的候选采购比较。

blocks.en: 5.1.1. Candidate Coverage.
blocks.zh: 5.1.1. 候选人覆盖率。

blocks.en: Table 2 compares candidate acquisition against the strongest retrieval baseline, OCG-Agent. Across the three datasets, PDG-F constructs substantially broader candidate pools, averaging roughly 250 to 690 items per request, compared with around 20 for OCG-Agent. Crucially, this expansion does not merely introduce noise, as pool recall approximately doubles or more across the three domains, increasing from 0.2102 to 0.4858 on Movie, from 0.2854 to 0.5481 on Book, and nearly tripling from 0.1672 to 0.4734 on Anime. This confirms that decomposing narrative preferences across dependency nodes effectively retrieves diverse, high-utility ground-truth items, establishing a much stronger candidate foundation for subsequent topological ranking. Importantly, because PDG-F scores candidates through deterministic graph accumulation rather than prompting-based listwise rerankers such as RankGPT, such candidate pool expansion avoids the pitfalls of context window limits ( Qin et al., 2024 ) , position bias ( Tang et al., 2024 ) , and prohibitive inference latency.
blocks.zh: 表2对照最强检索基线OCG-Agent对候选人的获取进行了比较。 在三个数据集中,PDG-F构建了大得多的候选人才库,平均每项请求约250至690项,而OCG-Agent约20项。 关键的是,这种扩张并不仅仅带来噪音,因为游泳池在三个领域上大约召回双倍或更多,在电影上从0.2102增加到0.4858,在书上从0.2854增加到0.5481,在Anime上从0.1672增加到0.4734,几乎增加了三倍. 这证实,不同依赖节点的叙事偏好实际上回收了各种高效用的地面实况项目,为随后的地形排名奠定了更强有力的候选基础。 重要的是,由于PDG-F通过确定性图表积累而不是通过RankGPT等基于列表的重新排名来评分候选人,这种候选人池的扩张避免了上下文窗口限制(秦等人,2024年),位置偏差(唐等人,2024年)和令人望而却步的推论延迟的陷阱.

blocks.en: Table 2. Candidate-pool size and relevant-item coverage.
blocks.zh: 图表 2. 候选人总数和相关项目的覆盖面。

blocks.en: 5.1.2. Recall across Recommendation Lengths.
blocks.zh: 5.1.2. 回顾整个建议长度。

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates how broader candidate acquisition translates into ranking recall across varying recommendation lengths. As k k grows from 1 to 50, the recall trajectories exhibit markedly different saturation behaviors. Due to its constrained candidate pool, OCG-Agent rapidly plateaus around k = 20 k=20 across all datasets, yielding minimal gains as the list extends further. In contrast, PDG-F with year maintains a continuous upward trajectory, consistently surfacing additional relevant items throughout longer lists. Remarkably, its Recall@10 alone surpasses the entire complete-pool recall of OCG-Agent across all three benchmarks. On Anime, OCG-Agent exhibits a slight advantage at the extreme top position, with a Recall@1 of 0.0492 versus 0.0359 for PDG-F with year, yet PDG-F rapidly overtakes it as k k reaches 10 and beyond. This demonstrates that the candidate coverage advantages of PDG-F become increasingly pronounced when presenting multi-item recommendation lists.
blocks.zh: 图2显示,更广泛征聘候选人将如何转化为不同建议长度的排序召回。 随着 k k 从 1 增长到 50 , 召回轨迹显示出明显不同的饱和行为. 由于候选人才库有限,OCG-Agent在所有数据集中快速高原在k=20k=20左右,随着名单的进一步扩大,收益微乎其微。 与此相反,PDG-F与年份保持连续上升的轨迹,在整个较长的清单中不断显示额外的相关项目。 值得注意的是,仅仅召回@10就超过了所有三项基准中OCG-Agent的完整集合召回。 在Anime上,OCG-Agent在极顶位置上表现出微弱的优势,PDG-F的回调@1为0.0492,而PDG-F的回调为0.0359,然而PDG-F迅速超过它,因为Kk达到10及以上. 这表明,在提交多项目建议清单时,PDG-F的候选覆盖范围优势越来越明显。

blocks.en: 5.1.3. Complementarity of Retrieved Items.
blocks.zh: 5.1.3. 检索物品的互补性。

blocks.en: Figure 3 further examines where the additional coverage comes from. Relevant items found exclusively by PDG-F account for 30.41%, 33.57%, and 38.85% of all ground-truth items on Movie, Book, and Anime, respectively, while those found exclusively by OCG-Agent account for 2.86%, 7.29%, and 8.24%. These proportions are computed per query and then macro-averaged. Thus, PDG-F’s coverage advantage includes a substantial number of relevant works absent from the baseline pools, illustrating the additional coverage obtained from candidate acquisition under different preference perspectives. OCG-Agent also retrieves some relevant items missed by PDG-F, indicating that the candidate sources remain partially complementary.
blocks.zh: 图3还审查了额外覆盖范围的来源。 完全由PDG-F发现的相关物品分别占电影、书籍和Anime上所有地面真实物品的30.41%、33.57%和38.85%,而完全由OCG-Agent发现的物品占2.86%、7.29%和8.24%。 这些比例是按查询计算,然后是宏观平均值。 因此,PDG-F的覆盖范围优势包括基线人才库中缺少大量相关工作,说明根据不同偏好角度从候选人采购中获取的额外覆盖面。 OCG-Agent还检索了PDG-F错过的一些相关物品,表明候选来源仍然部分互补.

blocks.en: 5.2. Ranking Analysis
blocks.zh: 5.2. 排名分析

blocks.en: We analyze node aggregation strategies, score discriminability, oracle performance gaps, and the role of dependency modeling.
blocks.zh: 我们分析节点汇总策略,评分歧视,甲骨文性能差距,以及依赖模型的作用.

blocks.en: Table 3. Evaluation of candidate ranking strategies.
blocks.zh: 图表 3. 评价候选人的排名战略。

blocks.en: 5.2.1. Ranking Strategy Comparison.
blocks.zh: 5.2.1. 排名战略比较。

blocks.en: Table 3 compares node aggregation strategies on identical candidate pools against a random ranking baseline. Mean aggregation degrades severely across all datasets because averaging dilutes decisive signals across nodes. Taking the maximum node score provides a viable baseline, confirming that prominent local matches offer useful discrimination. Notably, this maximum node score already benefits from our propagation strategy by inheriting contextual preference constraints from ancestor nodes. Even with this contextual advantage, the full additive strategy consistently achieves higher NDCG@10 across all domains, and even more notably, it more than doubles the performance on Book and Anime, demonstrating the effectiveness of our cumulative evidence design.
blocks.zh: 表3将相同候选人人才库的节点汇总战略与随机排名基线进行比较。 平均汇总在所有数据集中严重降解,因为平均稀释了各节点的决定性信号。 采用最高节点分数可提供一个可行的基线,确认显著的本地匹配提供了有益的区别。 值得注意的是,这一最大节点的得分已经受益于我们的传播战略,继承了祖先节点对背景的偏好限制。 即使有了这种背景优势,完整的添加剂策略也始终在所有领域都实现了更高的NDCG@10,更值得注意的是,它比Book和Anime上的性能翻了一番以上,证明了我们累积的证据设计的有效性.

blocks.en: 5.2.2. Graph Scores and Relevance.
blocks.zh: 5.2.2. 图表分数和相关性。

blocks.en: Figure 4 evaluates the discriminative power of the computed graph scores within the expanded candidate pools. Partitioning candidates into score deciles reveals that ground-truth relevant items are heavily concentrated in the top decile, achieving relevance rates of 17.97%, 8.01%, and 7.92% on Movie, Book, and Anime, respectively, compared with only 1.87%, 0.10%, and 0.18% in the bottom decile. This sharp separation directly reflects the scoring quality because candidates assigned high graph scores are significantly more likely to be truly relevant, whereas irrelevant candidates are successfully suppressed into lower deciles. The cross-domain consistency of this trend confirms that the graph score functions as a reliable relevance indicator, validating that evaluating evidence along interdependent preference paths effectively captures whether an item satisfies the user’s composite needs.
blocks.zh: 图4评价了在扩大的候选人人才库中计算出的图表分数的歧视性力量。 将考生分到分数十分显示,与地面事实相关的项目主要集中在最高十分数上,在电影、Book和Anime上的相关率分别为17.97%、8.01%和7.92%,而在最低十分数上的相关率分别为1.87%、0.10%和0.18%。 这种尖锐的离职直接反映了评分的质量,因为分配高分的考生更有可能真正具有相关性,而无关紧要考生则被成功压入较低的十级. 这一趋势的跨领域一致性证实,图表评分是可靠的相关指标,验证了按照相互依存的偏好路径评价证据的情况,从而有效地掌握了某一项目是否满足了用户的综合需求。

blocks.en: 5.2.3. Candidate Acquisition and Ranking Gaps.
blocks.zh: 5.2.3. 候选人获得和排名差距。

blocks.en: We finally examine Figure 5 to decompose the gap to ideal NDCG@10 into candidate-pool coverage and within-pool ranking accuracy. Across all domains, PDG-F achieves markedly higher pool-oracle upper bounds than OCG-Agent, confirming that multi-path acquisition builds a far stronger candidate foundation. At the same time, the visible ranking gaps highlight that while candidate retrieval raises the performance ceiling, ranking retrieved relevant items into top positions remains the primary bottleneck and leaves substantial room for future improvement.
blocks.zh: 我们最终检查图5,将差距分解为理想的NDCG@10,以进入候选集合覆盖和集合内部排名精度. 在所有领域,PDG-F实现了明显高于OCG-Agent的集合-oracle上界,证实多路径获取可以建立更强大的候选基础. 与此同时,明显的排名差距突出表明,虽然候选人检索提高了业绩上限,但将检索到的相关项目排到最高位置仍然是主要的瓶颈,为今后的改进留有相当大的余地。

blocks.en: 5.2.4. Dependency Modeling Analysis.
blocks.zh: 5.2.4. 依赖性模型分析。

blocks.en: The empirical comparison between PDG-F and OCG-Agent naturally constitutes an ablation over dependency modeling. Specifically, our preference nodes refine the dynamic attribute representations of OCG-Agent through redesigned extraction sources and field specifications, while the overarching innovation lies in establishing directed qualification graphs. In the absence of directional dependency edges, candidate acquisition reduces to uncoordinated retrieval across isolated preference nodes. Furthermore, lacking the underlying graph structure precludes our topological path ranking, forcing candidate evaluation to revert to standard prompting-based reranking via RankGPT. Under this double degradation, the framework essentially degenerates into the baseline pipeline of OCG-Agent. The substantial performance margins across all evaluation domains, as shown in Table 1 , therefore confirm that directional qualification modeling serves as the decisive driver for enhanced candidate acquisition and relevance discrimination.
blocks.zh: PDG-F和OCG-Agent之间的实证比较自然构成依赖模型的衰减. 具体来说,我们的首选节点通过重新设计提取源和实地规格,完善OCG-Agent的动态属性表述,而总体创新在于建立定向资格图. 在没有定向依赖边缘的情况下,候选人的获取减少为在孤立的偏好节点之间不协调的检索。 此外,缺乏基本的图表结构排除了我们的地形路径排名,迫使候选人评价恢复到标准,通过RankGPT促使重新排序。 在这种双重退化下,框架基本上退化为OCG-Agent的基线管道。 因此,如表1所示,所有评价领域的业绩差幅很大,这证实,定向资格模型是加强候选人获取和相关性歧视的决定性动力。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6个 结论

blocks.en: We presented PDG-F, a framework for narrative-driven recommendation that captures how user preferences qualify one another through directed acyclic graphs. By carrying these qualification relationships into candidate acquisition and topological evidence accumulation, the framework connects narrative understanding with evidence-based recommendation. Experiments across three domains demonstrate broader relevant-item coverage and improved recommendation performance over competitive baselines. Oracle analysis further shows that this broader coverage raises the attainable performance ceiling, while the remaining ranking gap motivates more accurate evidence scoring to realize that potential.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PDG-F,这是一个由叙事驱动的建议框架,它通过定向循环图来捕捉用户偏好如何相互限定。 通过将这些资格关系纳入候选人获取和地形证据积累,该框架将叙述性理解与基于证据的建议联系起来。 跨越三个领域的实验表明,相关项目涵盖面更广,在竞争性基线上建议业绩有所改善。 甲骨文分析还表明,这种更广泛的覆盖面提高了可实现的业绩上限,而剩余的排名差距则促使更准确的证据评分,以实现这一潜力。
